articles.title: GHSA: mail-parser is vulnerable to polynomial ReDoS in email header parsing
articles.summary:
### Summary

Two regular expressions used while parsing email headers backtrack
polynomially on attacker-controlled input. Parsing a single small, well-formed
email can consume minutes to hours of CPU, denying service to any process that
parses untrusted mail.

Both are reachable from an ordinary `parse_from_string()`, `parse_from_bytes()`
or `parse_from_file()` call — no special API, option, or m

The wrapped error was treated as one the app raised deliberately, so in production its `message` and `data` were sent to the client in the error page payload (`__NUXT_DATA__`) and in JSON error responses. When using the webpack or rspack builder, the dev server serves built client chunks to any request whose `Host` header matches its `Origin`/`Referer`, or that carries `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`. articles.title: GHSA: Nuxt: Incomplete fix for GHSA-6gq8-jgmh-3ffp: an encoded slash (`%2F`) in the request path bypasses route rules on catch-all page routes
articles.summary:
### Summary

Nuxt matches route rules against the request path with encoded slashes (`%2F`) left encoded, while the page router decodes them into route params. A request that spells a slash as `%2F` can therefore render a page through a catch-all route without the route rules configured for the path it resolves to. articles.title: GHSA: SvelteKit: Build-time server-only module import guard could fail, resulting in server secrets being statically replaced in client bundle
articles.summary: Under certain circumstances, server-only imports, which typically cannot be included in the client bundle, could make their way into it, potentially exposing secrets. This could only occur when those server-only imports were made through `src/params.js`.

articles.title: GHSA: SvelteKit: DoS while parsing form data from a remote functions `form`
articles.summary: This only affects applications using the experimental remote functions flag and utilizing the `form`, `query`, or `command` remote functions. A specially-crafted request could block the event loop for extended periods of time during parsing.

articles.title: GHSA: AIOHTTP: Base64 multipart parts bypass client_max_size
articles.summary:
### Summary

When reading a multipart part with `Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64`, `BodyPartReader.read_chunk()` kept reading until the chunk length was a multiple of 4, with no byte limit. A part with a short `Content-Length`, or a long run of whitespace, could cause the entire remaining body to be read into memory within a single call before any size check, or spin on the event loop.

articles.title: GHSA: SvelteKit: Private `query.batch` functions could collide, producing unexpected parameter / function combinations
articles.summary: Under certain circumstances, private (non-exported) `query.batch` functions could end up sharing a batch, resulting in the arguments from one function being passed to another. This only affects apps using the experimental remote functions flag and non-exported `query.batch` functions.

articles.title: GHSA: SvelteKit: Protocol-relative module import during server-side route resolution allows cross-origin script execution
articles.summary: If an attacker could, using some form of social engineering or other exploit, get a user to use client-side navigation to navigate to a specially-crafted link, the attacker could cause code from another domain to be imported and run on the user's machine. This only affected apps with `router.resolution: 'server'`.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129552 — CVSS 9.8
articles.summary: Tensei through 0.11.5 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in @tensei/auth that falls back to the hard-coded JWT signing key 'auth-secret-key' when JWT_SECRET is unset. Unauthenticated attackers can sign tokens with arbitrary user ids accepted by populateContextFromToken to impersonate any user, including administrators.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129551 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: Tensei through 0.11.5 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in parseSortFromStringToObject of @tensei/rest that allows unauthenticated attackers to set Object.prototype properties via the sort parameter. Attackers can send a sort value like __proto__.<name>:<value> to list, fetch-one, update or delete routes before authorization, altering application logic and causing denial of service.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129550 — CVSS 9.1
articles.summary: Tensei through 0.11.5 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in @tensei/auth that allows unauthenticated or authenticated users to assign themselves arbitrary roles via the exposed User Roles field. Attackers can supply a roles array during registration, a POST to the users route, or a PATCH to their own record to gain administrator permissions.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129549 — CVSS 6.1
articles.summary: Tensei through 0.11.5 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the @tensei/media plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload dangerous file types via the files/upload route. Attackers can set the multipart Content-Type to upload HTML or SVG files served from the application origin, causing stored cross-site scripting and storage consumption.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129548 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: Kalmia through 0.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows read-only authenticated users to upload HTML or SVG files via the upload-file endpoint without type restrictions. Attackers can share links to files served unauthenticated through the file get route, executing JavaScript in the admin origin to steal administrator JWTs from localStorage.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129547 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: Kalmia through 0.2.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in RsPressMiddleware that allows unauthenticated attackers to access private documentation by supplying any non-empty viewToken cookie. Attackers can send requests with a forged viewToken cookie, which is never validated as a JWT, to read all pages and assets of RequireAuth documentation sites.

articles.title: CVE-2026-129545 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: Kalmia through 0.2.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to modify any account via the /kal-api/auth/user/edit endpoint. Attackers holding only read permission can set their admin flag and 'all' permission or reset an administrator's password to fully take over the instance.

articles.title: CVE-2026-110941 — CVSS 6.8
articles.summary: Mattermost Desktop App versions <=6.3 6.0.3 6.3.2.0 fail to monitor secondary browser windows in the local network access filter which allows an attacker-controlled server to access private network resources via opening pop-out or widget windows. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00778

articles.title: CVE-2026-63245 — CVSS 7.3
articles.summary: A local privilege escalation (LPE) vulnerability in the Audigy Rx driver’s Emupia2k.sys file could allow a local attacker with low privilege access to gain higher privileges, such as administrator rights.
